issue_request: FHIR-51403 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking editors to review Device, DeviceDefinition, and DeviceAssociation pages and source directories for correct formatting of element names, specifically code font for element paths such as Device.property.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by ee276a27bffcc3d64615de0195a307220a58262e and PR #3574, which formatted the cited Device.property example plus Device.status/.availabilityStatus and Observation/DeviceAssociation element references in Device and DeviceAssociation narrative pages.
additional_context: Device, DeviceDefinition, and DeviceAssociation are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later R6 ballot-note commits for FHIR-53625, FHIR-53626, and FHIR-53628 added new active narrative text after the initial application, and current StructureDefinition markdown still had unformatted element paths in detailed-definition fields. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: Updated active narrative XHTML in source/device, source/devicedefinition, and source/deviceassociation with <code> styling for remaining element paths; updated active Device and DeviceDefinition StructureDefinition markdown comments/requirements with backtick code styling; corrected the DeviceDefinition spelling in the same touched detailed-definition text. Generated-looking SVG diagram artifacts were not manually edited.
